calls.event: 3rd Largest Company end of October?
calls.method: market cap = price x shares outstanding (SEC cover page); P(rank 3) from 2494 JOINT historical windows of 18 trading days — one calendar window applied to every rival at once, so their correlation is the one that actually happened rather than an assumed one. calls.question: Will Microsoft be the third-largest company in the world by market cap on October 31?
calls.subject: MSFT
